format: cell = [ring5 (5 statuses N/B/R), u, pL, pR, tL, tR, oth[3]] as in search/rule_lp.py SigCatalogue; keys are repr() of window tuples (prev Info, cur EFrame, next Info) as used by SigCatalogue.window_options
how_to_use: 1. A completion whose cell is not in axis_cells is impossible (sound): every block seen from its axis line has all cell features visible, so its cell is the image of an automaton window that satisfies all facts (automaton_facts); the set was validated on 11,407 real blocks (0 outside).  2. flank_removed[key] lists group completions (tuple of (u,pO) per member) removed; cap_removed[key] lists (s23,s34,far) completions with no oth option inside axis_cells.  3. sat_removed_* are extra removals proved by pattern SAT (partial sweeps).
